Reserven gælder det filsystem, backupmap: The reserve applies to the filesystem holding the backup folder. Backup pauses on low space; large files may still need more space.
Overblikket sammenligner det seneste Goo: Coverage compares the latest Google index with local files. Shared-album or archived items outside the main library may appear missing. It is not proof of full coverage.
Første kontrol gemmer SHA-256 som refere: The first check records a SHA-256 baseline; later checks show changes. Supported photos are decoded and videos checked with ffmpeg (up to five minutes per file). Unknown formats and timeouts are unverified. Checking can take a long time and changes no media files.
Kun identiske bytes grupperes. Album-har: Only identical bytes are grouped. Album hard links are excluded. The report shows up to 200 groups and 20 locations per group. No files are deleted.
